description: Installation of a water-source heat pump system.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Osterley Park National Trust Ownership Boundary Plan dated 25 July 2016, Osterley Park National Trust Ownership Boundary Plan dated 26 July 2016, Ecological Appraisal ref: P19-422, Arboricultural Report dated 3 July 2019, Osterley Park WSHP - Archaeology Background & Assessment, received: 20/08/2019.
BSL-JS-0003-Osterley Collector Plan, BSL-JS-0004-Mansion House Plant Room Layout Rev P1, Osterley Park - REI Project Trenching Route and Heat Array Location, Stables: Internal heat main pipe routes, Mansion: Internal pipe routes, and Osterley Park WSHP Installation Project: Building Entry and Typical installation details, received: 23/10/2019.
Planning and Heritage Statement received: 25/10/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
